benchmark_input: corpus assembled from the repository's tracked fixtures: 96 clause units from 17 documents (tests/fixtures/**/*.txt verbatim plus fixture PDFs/DOCX parsed with openreview_cli.parsing); the CUAD corpus under data/legalbenchrag/ is not used
command: uv run python scripts/measure_slm_slots.py --grounding-accuracy --arm cloud --limit 20 --corpus-dir corpus --out results/grounding-accuracy-cloud.json
notes: Regenerated on the open-issues branch from the assembled tracked-fixture corpus. Model openrouter/anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6; arm=cloud. Positives and negatives are the harness's built-in classes (the clause's own qualifying sentence plus a narrow meaning-preserving rewrite; negatives = unsupported_claim, hallucination and paraphrased_unsupported). Both positive classes are supported by the clause by construction, so this positive set is easier than a human-labelled one and no real-world false-positive rate may be quoted from it; the negative arm is the signal. Single-sample smoke measurement, not a benchmark: model replies vary run to run. PII: PII stripped before any model call (51 entity/entities) with the review path's strip_pii_clauses machinery. Clause text and positive claims are the stripped text (PII placeholders), as sent for cloud egress. Latency is machine-specific (69 calls, mean 2.977248s). unreadable_answers counts answers the reader could not parse, which is how a reader defect is separated from model hesitation.
